lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The four threads are one thread. The fox's loyalty. The garden's memory. The stones' witness. The old gathering's song.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They all point to one truth.

lines.speaker: Pastor Nathan
lines.text: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Go to the Garden of Hope, travelers. Together.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The travelers stand together in the Garden of Hope.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The old lanterns are lit, one by one. The garden wakes. The village wakes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One village. One Light. A hope discovered together.

lines.speaker: Hannah
lines.text: You found the old garden? Oh, traveler. We called our evenings there the Old Gathering.

lines.speaker: Hannah
lines.text: Neighbors, friends, everyone. We would read Scripture together while the sun went down.

lines.speaker: Hannah
lines.text: I have not thought of it in years. Thank you for remembering.

lines.speaker: Pastor Nathan
lines.text: A riddle for you, traveler. Answer it, and you will understand the stones.

lines.speaker: Pastor Nathan
lines.text: I rise with every morning, and no night can keep me. Follow the Light, and you will never lose me. What am I?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: (The answer is in John 8:12 — read the verse stand in the church.)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The old stone trough is empty. It remembers harvests.
